b: ^Ibrahim Diallo: I'll keep to my work, if it's all the same to you.

s0: ^Hello. I'm waiting on the office desktops to image. The swap was booked late, so I won't be on tonight's list.
s1: ^Still imaging. Forty minutes a machine, and there are six.
s2: ^If the reception PCs boot by six, I'll call it a win.
s3: ^Nobody thanks IT until the screens go black.

ex_six_oclock: ^Joanne Pell: Twelve contractors at six, all new.
^Ibrahim Diallo: And the reception PCs half swapped.
^Joanne Pell: They can sign in on paper, then.
^Ibrahim Diallo: Paper never needs me. That's its flaw.
ex_not_on_the_rota: ^Ibrahim Diallo: Neither of us is on tonight's rota.
^Joanne Pell: Your swap was booked late, then?
^Ibrahim Diallo: After the rota went out. You're early.
^Joanne Pell: Inductions today. Nobody knows I'm in.
ex_stay_out_of_the_halls: ^Joanne Pell: Robert says keep out of the halls.
^Ibrahim Diallo: Till the crew's done. Fine by me.
^Joanne Pell: Not at this hour, no thank you.
